mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and 50 degrees outside the Verona Public Library, with a waning crescent moon overhead.

The City of Verona has released a schedule for upcoming pavement repairs starting November 9, and residents are reminded that they can stay informed on city projects by subscribing to the official digital newsletter.
There is plenty to do, including yoga today at Insight Wellness, Art House 360 events today, and trivia this Thursday at Hop Haus Brewing Co.
Regarding local safety, on October 25, police responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a man for O W I.
Today is a great day to stop by the local Culver's for the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day, as they are currently open and serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
